archetypes.name: dyn-convention-lint
archetypes.rationale: New hard-ban lint defines the protected convention boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shared-convention lint for false positives and false negatives. Check that owner allowlists, production scope exclusions, pragma handling, and the split from lifecycle-prefix-literal match the changed tests. Pay special attention to whether heading regex detection catches the known drift class without scanning docstrings or the lint implementation itself. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
